decisions.reason: The clarified horizontal peak alignment is an independent positioning rule and does not alter the existing requirement that the accent literally duplicate the Hero V terminal geometry.

The separate second-V height decision in the same message is already fully represented by the candidate's message-138 INTRODUCE Event; the accent peak-alignment modification requires no additional candidate change.
The source changes the Hero V–accent peak alignment, while the second V's construction, derivation, and right-arm reach remain valid unchanged.
Requiring the Hero V and accent peaks to share a horizontal line does not necessarily modify any current Hero V geometry attribute.
The peak-alignment refinement does not change the E and L construction principles, aesthetic qualities, role, or terminal constraints.
The source specifies vertical peak alignment and a separate second-V hierarchy, but it does not change wordmark kerning or cohesive reading rhythm.
The geometric peak-alignment clarification has no necessary effect on the deferred champagne material treatment or its application constraint.
The source does not alter the selected all-caps case treatment or its status as the preferred initial direction.
The wordmark geometry refinement is unrelated to accessible review-image delivery formats.
